verdict: Monolithic Power's sales rocketed 63% to a record $1.2B — its first billion-dollar quarter — as AI data centers devoured its power chips; GAAP profit rose 51% to $271M.

kpis.label: Non-GAAP EPS
kpis.note: the gap is mostly stock-based pay

kpis.label: Enterprise Data revenue
kpis.note: +165% YoY — AI servers are 42% of sales

segments.name: Enterprise Data
segments.note: Power chips for AI servers and data centers — the explosion in AI computing made this the largest end market, 42% of all revenue.

segments.name: Storage & Computing
segments.note: Power management for storage drives, PCs and computing hardware.

segments.name: Communications
segments.note: Power solutions for network switches and optical modules — riding the same AI buildout.

segments.name: Automotive
segments.note: Power chips for electric vehicles and car electronics.

segments.name: Industrial
segments.note: Power for factory automation, medical and industrial equipment.

segments.name: Consumer
segments.note: Power for home appliances and consumer electronics — the only shrinking market.

opex.name: Selling, general and administrative
opex.note: Sales, back office — and a large amount of stock-based pay for employees, which GAAP counts as an expense.

opex.name: Research and development
opex.note: Designing the next power chips — also includes significant stock-based compensation.

otherDetail: Interest and investment income on the company's cash, net.
oneTimers: No one-off gains or charges — but note the GAAP/non-GAAP gap: non-GAAP net income was $403M vs $271M GAAP, almost entirely because GAAP subtracts roughly $120M+ of stock-based compensation. Whether that is a 'real' cost is the standing debate with fast-growing chip companies.

takeaways.title: AI is the whole story
takeaways.text: Enterprise Data revenue nearly tripled to $507M as AI servers need far more power conversion than ordinary servers. Communications (+135%) rode the same wave through optical modules and switches.

takeaways.title: First billion-dollar quarter
takeaways.text: Revenue crossed $1B for the first time, up 23% in a single quarter. Management says installed capacity can already support $6B of annual revenue, heading for $8B by late 2027.

takeaways.title: Two profit numbers, one debate
takeaways.text: Non-GAAP EPS was $8.19 vs $5.51 GAAP. The difference is mainly stock-based pay — real dilution for shareholders, but not cash out the door.

footerNote: Figures are rounded to whole $M from the release's thousands presentation, with $1M of rounding absorbed in cost of revenue. Monolithic Power reports one operating segment; the sources above are its end markets.
